title: Looks just like the picture, arrived in good condition and fast shipping. A lot bigger than I expected though.
text: Looks just like the picture, arrived in good condition and fast shipping. A lot bigger than I expected though.. Great shakers arrived super fast and in good condition. I have not yet used them but I washed and prepped them for use later on in my kitchen :) I like the fact they come with a little spoon to handle the pepper/salt as well. The product description is a little off imo because when you see the product though it does specifiy that the are both pepper shakers. Otherwise I have no complaints maybe just that they are a lot bigger than one would expect. I mean I had read the reviews that they were big, but I didn't know how much it'd probably be useful if you added the size in the description for future buyers. :)
